steps.title: Grouping, regions, coverage renderer, Sinkhorn and LS objectives (work item 1)
steps.result: Coverage mass on stock-rendered lit pixels at the ground truth: median 99.6% (min 95.2%) over 20 grad grains; ground-truth map groups into exactly the 497 grains; Sinkhorn at ground truth 0.4-0.7 px^2 after component + ratio filters and reach 3 px.

steps.title: Objective bias: where each objective's minimum sits against the ground truth
steps.result: Only the strict cost (grain mean) puts its optimum within 0.01 deg of the ground truth (0.006, 0.008 deg); Sinkhorn variants are flat within 0.031-0.041 deg (objective <1% lower); intensity-weighted Sinkhorn 0.0074 / 0.026 deg; least squares 0.012 / 0.042 deg.

steps.title: Deformed samples: random (rand) and correlated (corr3) voxel-to-voxel misorientation, RMS 0.5-5 deg
steps.result: Rendered: rand 22.4M lit pixels, corr3 19.2M; coverage mass on lit pixels at the ground truth 97-99%. At 2 / 5 deg, 69% / 97% of neighbour pairs in rand exceed 2 deg (flood-fill grouping fails there).

steps.title: Survey of strain code in older C++ branches
steps.result: Strain only in the C++ image simulator (g = O M g0, M ~ I - eps); no fitter or cost exists; branches identical. Reuse convention, .mic columns 13-18, config keys.

steps.title: Optimizer Pareto on G20 (20 grad grains, painted start)
steps.result: Frontier: grain-field CMA on the strict cost. At 100 objective evaluations per voxel, 3 of 853 voxels > 0.1 deg (the 3 paint errors) vs 18 for AR3 per-voxel CMA, at half its wall time; 400 evaluations: median 0.0062 deg. Per-voxel CMA alone, quadratic fields and Sinkhorn/LS basin stages add nothing from the painted start (Sinkhorn: 700x wall time).

steps.title: Robustness on rand / corr3 (0.5-5 deg RMS), grain-centre start
steps.result: Local fits recover only voxels within ~0.5 deg of their start. corr3 0.5 deg: 99% to 32% of voxels > 0.1 deg (median 0.414 to 0.071); corr3 1 deg: 53% (LS + field + coarse polish); corr3 2-5 deg and rand >= 1 deg: almost nothing. The linear field alone does not move them; coarse per-voxel steps (0.3 deg) beat fine ones.

steps.title: Far starts: per-voxel step ladder and neighbour continuation on rand / corr3
steps.result: Step ladder 1.0/0.3/0.05 deg with 61 evaluations per leg: corr3 0.5/1/2 deg -> 9%/11%/47% of voxels > 0.1 deg (GO4 best 32/53/93%), at 196 eval/voxel. rand stays hard (51% at 0.5 deg). The strict cost prefers the ground truth for ~all unresolved voxels: a search problem, and a high strict cost flags them.

steps.title: Larger per-voxel ladders (3 deg first leg) on rand / corr3
steps.result: L/366/3 (4 legs x 91, 401 eval/voxel): corr3 0.5/1/2/5 deg -> 3/9/31/72% of voxels > 0.1 deg (medians ~0.01 deg up to 2 deg); rand 48/53/77/83%. 5 deg needs a global per-voxel search (I36, blocked on ray-index cost).

steps.title: Strain in the forward model (SpotModel and stock renderer) and the strained sample
steps.result: Opt-in strain, g = O M g0 with M = (I+eps)^-1, tests pin the sign and frame; default bit-identical. Sample `strain` (RMS 1e-4 / 5e-4 / 1e-3 per grain). Near field: 0.2-0.5 px spot shift per 1e-3 strain; intensity Sinkhorn rises 10% at ~1e-3 per component; leaving strain out raises it 14-44% at 1e-3, 0.3% at 1e-4.

steps.title: Per-grain strain fit (field + 6 strain numbers) on the coverage cost
steps.result: Median strain error (12 grains) at levels 1e-4/5e-4/1e-3: strain only at ground-truth orientation 1.7e-4/1.9e-4/2.0e-4 (floor ~2e-4, half of pixel/distance); field + strain from ground truth 3.1e-4/3.4e-4/3.8e-4; from painted start 6.7e-4/6.3e-4/5.3e-4. Joint fits stop above the ground truth's cost in 19 of 24 grains: optimizer-limited. Orientation stays at 0.010-0.016 deg.

steps.title: Joint orientation + strain fit that reaches the optimum
steps.result: Median strain error at 1e-4/5e-4/1e-3 from the painted start: joint 2400 evaluations 6.5/5.7/4.5e-4 with only 2 of 12 grains short of the ground truth's cost (10 of 12 below it): objective-limited, orientation (0.01 deg) trades with strain (2-4e-4). Staged (strain first, then joint) 7.1/3.4/3.0e-4; floor at the ground-truth orientation 1.7/1.9/2.0e-4.

steps.title: Fix the orientation, then strain alone
steps.result: Median strain error at 1e-4/5e-4/1e-3 from the painted start: field fitted at zero strain on coverage, then strain alone 1.5/5.3/6.0e-4; field on the strict cost 4.7/5.4/6.3e-4 (staged joint fit 7.1/3.4/3.0e-4). Fits without a strain model take up the strain as rotation (0.009/0.022/0.040 deg). At a fixed exact orientation the strain fit scatters between 1e-4 and 3e-4: the coverage cost is flat there, so a sharper sub-pixel cost (I40) is next.

steps.title: Sharper sub-pixel strain cost
steps.result: Strain-only at the ground-truth orientation, median error at 1e-4/5e-4/1e-3: signed distance 1.8/1.2/0.9e-3, intensity 2.5/1.9/1.5e-3, against coverage 1.7/1.6/2.7e-4. Both are sharp (repeat scatter 6e-5 and 1e-4) but biased: one-sided costs reward pulling the predicted footprint into the spot. Painted-start fit not run (rule). Next: a two-sided cost (centroid match or symmetric distance), I42.

steps.title: Two-sided sub-pixel strain cost
steps.result: Centroid match per spot: at the ground-truth orientation 1.3/2.2/1.7e-4 at 1e-4/5e-4/1e-3 with repeat scatter 5e-6 (coverage 1.7/1.6/2.7e-4); sharper at 1e-3 only, so I42 no by the rule. From the painted start (staged) 1.4/2.2/3.7e-4 against coverage 7.1/3.4/3.0e-4, but the orientation drifts to 0.06 deg (coverage 0.012). Chamfer cost biased. Next: hybrid, coverage for orientation and centroids for strain (I43).

steps.title: Hybrid cost: coverage for orientation, centroids for strain
steps.result: cen + 8 x coverage, staged from the painted start: median strain error 1.9/1.5/2.2e-4 at 1e-4/5e-4/1e-3 (coverage 7.1/3.4/3.0e-4, centroids alone 1.4/2.2/3.7e-4) with orientation 0.008-0.012 deg (centroids alone 0.06-0.09). I43 yes. At the ground-truth orientation 9.9e-5/1.4e-4/1.1e-4. Next: confirm on 12 grains per level (I44).

steps.title: Confirm the hybrid strain fit on 36 grains
steps.result: 12 grains per level, painted start, staged: hybrid lambda 8 median strain error 2.3/1.5/2.1e-4 at 1e-4/5e-4/1e-3 against coverage 4.6/2.8/6.3e-4 on the same grains (9-10 of 12 better per level), orientation 0.009-0.017 deg; lambda 16 2.3/1.6/2.3e-4. Confirmed. Remaining: a tail of 1e-3 grains at 4-9e-4; CMA costs about 50 s per grain.

steps.title: Gauss-Newton on centroid residuals
steps.result: 36 grains, painted start: Gauss-Newton (Tukey weights) gives strain 1.2/1.3/2.9e-4 at 1e-4/5e-4/1e-3 in 10 s per grain (CMA hybrid 2.3/1.5/2.1e-4 in 53 s), but orientation 0.021/0.039 deg at 5e-4/1e-3 (field gradient from the zero-strain coverage leg); with a hybrid polish 1.6/1.9/2.3e-4, 0.025 deg at 1e-3, 23 s. Rule not met; next: refit the gradient (I45).

steps.title: Alternate field-gradient refit and Gauss-Newton
steps.result: 36 grains, painted start: with one or two gradient refits Gauss-Newton gives strain 1.2/1.2/3.1e-4 and orientation 0.009/0.014/0.034 deg at 24 s per grain (CMA hybrid 2.3/1.5/2.1e-4, 0.011/0.009/0.017 deg, 53 s). 5e-4 fixed, 1e-3 not: on grains with few spots Gauss-Newton escapes past the Tukey cut-off. Rule not met; next: freeze inliers, fall back (I46).

steps.title: Stop the Gauss-Newton escape
steps.result: 36 grains, painted start: frozen per-stage weights plus a CMA-hybrid fallback for grains with fewer than 40 spots (5 grains) give strain 1.3/1.3/2.4e-4 at 19 s per grain (CMA hybrid 2.3/1.5/2.1e-4, 53 s), orientation 0.009/0.015/0.028 deg: 1e-3 orientation over the 0.02 limit. Two grains stall (all stages skipped). Next: fall back on stalls, polish large-strain grains (I47).

steps.title: Fast strain fit: fallback on stalls, polish large strains
steps.result: 36 grains, painted start: Gauss-Newton with CMA-hybrid fallback (9 grains) and a hybrid polish for strain above 6e-4 (5 grains) gives strain 1.3/1.3/2.1e-4 and orientation 0.009/0.015/0.020 deg at 25 s per grain, matching the CMA hybrid (2.3/1.5/2.1e-4, 0.011/0.009/0.017 deg) in half its time. I47 yes.

steps.title: Strain fits on noisy images
steps.result: Detector noise model (edge flips, hot pixels, blobs), 36 grains: CMA hybrid noisy 2.5/1.9/2.8e-4 (clean 2.3/1.5/2.1e-4), robust; fast fit noisy 1.8/2.7/3.7e-4 (clean 1.3/1.3/2.1e-4), not robust. Orientation within 0.03 deg for both. I48 no. Next: noise-robust centroids (I49).

steps.title: Noise-robust observed centroids
steps.result: Fast fit on noisy images with binary-weight centroids: strain 4.9/4.6/6.7e-4 (isolated pixels removed: 5.1/5.0/5.9e-4), worse than intensity weights (1.8/2.7/3.7e-4): the intensities carry the sub-pixel position (partial pixel coverage). I49 no. Next: intensity weights with isolated pixels removed (I50).

steps.title: Intensity centroids without isolated pixels
steps.result: Fast fit with isolated lit pixels removed from intensity-weighted centroids: noisy strain 2.2/2.3/3.3e-4 (before 1.8/2.7/3.7e-4), orientation <= 0.025 deg, but 26.4 s per grain against the 25.3 s limit; clean unchanged (1.3/1.4/2.3e-4). I50 no, on time alone. Strain line time-boxed; next G1b.

steps.title: Cached ray index and gated global search (G1b)
steps.result: Ray pairing cached per sample (corr3 19 min, rand 48 min, once; loads in 0.01 s). Ladder + seed path on voxels with strict cost > 0.15: voxels above 0.1 deg at 0.5/1/2/5 deg corr3 3/5/9/36% (was 3/9/31/72%), rand 26/15/52/44% (was 48/53/77/83%), at 0.3/0.6 s per voxel. I36 yes.

steps.title: Rocking curve on the images (G2b, part 1)
steps.result: Emulated rocking (alpha 0.3 and 1.0 deg; 11% and 100% of lit pixels spread past one frame): grain-field strict fit on G20 keeps its median (0.0149, 0.0134 against 0.0146 deg) but loses one grain to the acceptance gate (20 of 853 voxels above 0.1 deg against 3). Harm by the rule; the model needs no rocking curve to find orientations, the strict-cost gate becomes less reliable.

steps.title: Detector PSF on the images (G2b)
steps.result: Gaussian PSF before the threshold: sigma 0.5 px leaves the fast strain fit at 1.4/1.3/2.8e-4; sigma 1.0 px breaks it (2.3/2.7/5.7e-4, orientation up to 0.06 deg) and raises the orientation-fit median from 0.0146 to 0.0192 deg; both sigmas lose grain 197 to the strict-cost gate. Next: PSF-aware predicted coverage (I52).

steps.title: PSF-aware predicted coverage (G2b)
steps.result: On 1 px PSF images the fast strain fit with PSF-aware coverage gives 2.3/2.6/6.8e-4 (sharp coverage 2.3/2.7/5.7e-4): no gain. Gauss-Newton-only grains degrade as much, so merged spots (contaminated centroids) are the cause. I52 no.

steps.title: Poisson likelihood as orientation objective (G2a)
steps.result: GO1 bias test on grains 381/302: Poisson deviance (b = 0.5) optimum 0.0101/0.0060 deg from the ground truth (strict 0.0060/0.0082, least squares 0.0117/0.0423, intensity Sinkhorn 0.0074/0.0263): best smooth objective, but misses the 0.01 deg rule by 0.0001 on grain 381. I18 no. Next: structure-factor-constrained scales (I22).

steps.title: Poisson likelihood with structure-factor scales (G2a)
steps.result: Tying the per-reflection scales to F / (|sin eta| sin 2theta): optimum 0.0092/0.0303 deg from the ground truth on grains 381/302 (free scales 0.0101/0.0060). I22 no; the tied scales misfit the observed relative intensities.

steps.title: Neighbour pass after the gated seed path (G1b)
steps.result: Adding N/30/0.3 after L/366/3,G/15/0.15: corr3 2/4/9/33% and rand 25/13/48/41% above 0.1 deg at 0.5/1/2/5 deg (was 3/5/9/36% and 26/15/52/44%), +1% time; a second seed pass adds nothing. I51 no (rand 2 deg target 35%).

steps.title: Why voxels stay wrong after the G1b pipeline (diagnosis)
steps.result: Every voxel still wrong after ladder + seed path + neighbour pass was gated, and its strict cost at the ground truth is far lower than at its end (rand 2 deg: 0.079 against 0.393): search failures, not objective failures. The seed candidates miss the ground truth. Next: wider search (I54).

steps.title: Wider search for voxels the seed path misses (G1b)
steps.result: After ladder + seed path + neighbour pass: all-candidates seed path (W) takes rand to 25/5/21/14% and corr3 to 2/3/3/21% above 0.1 deg at 0.5/1/2/5 deg (0.9 / 0.4 s per voxel); adding the grid search (rand only) gives 17/2/7/6%, wrong voxels 229 -> 25 of 1,043, at 4 s per voxel. I54 yes.

steps.title: Grid search on corr3 and final per-voxel polish (G1b)
steps.result: Full search + polish: corr3 1/1/0.4/7% above 0.1 deg at 0.5/1/2/5 deg (grid search: 5 deg 21% -> 10%), rand 16/1.4/5/4%; medians 0.005-0.009 deg. I55 no: rand 0.5 deg near misses (0.1-0.75 deg) sit below the strict-cost gate.

steps.title: Split merged spots before centroids (G2b)
steps.result: Assigning lit pixels to grain or neighbour before centroids leaves the 1 px PSF strain fit at 2.4/2.7/4.9e-4 (I53 no); clean unaffected. Cause: the region area-ratio filter drops blur-enlarged spots (a grain keeps 58% of its spots). Next: widen it (I56).

steps.title: Widen the region area-ratio filter (G2b)
steps.result: Ratio filter 0.8-2.5 instead of 0.8-1.6: on 1 px PSF images the fast strain fit improves to 2.1/2.1/3.5e-4 (from 2.3/2.7/5.7e-4) but misses the limits (I56 no). On clean images it improves to 1.3/1.2/1.4e-4 with orientation <= 0.013 deg (was 1.3/1.3/2.1e-4, 0.020 deg), 35 s per grain.

steps.title: Wider ratio filter on noisy images
steps.result: Noisy images, fast fit with region ratio filter 2.5: 1.6/2.6/3.1e-4 (with intclean 2.0/2.5/2.7e-4), orientation <= 0.017 deg, 38-40 s per grain: better than with 1.6 (1.8/2.7/3.7e-4) but misses 1.25 x the noisy CMA hybrid at 5e-4. I57 no. Strain line closed.

steps.title: Lower gate for rand near misses (G1b)
steps.result: A second W,X pass at gate 0.11 takes rand to 4.5/0.4/3.3/3.2% above 0.1 deg at 0.5/1/2/5 deg (was 16/1.4/5/4%), medians 0.005-0.006 deg, 8 s per voxel. I58 yes. Run took 140 min (over its 2 h budget; its watcher ended in a session restart).

steps.title: Intragranular strain gradient (owner request)
steps.result: Sample straing (grain mean + in-plane linear gradient). With 6 + 12 strain numbers per grain the mean is recovered to 1.3-2.9e-4 (a uniform fit misses it by 3.6e-4 / 1.0e-3 at 5e-4 / 1e-3), but the gradient is only partly seen: relative error 0.45 at 1e-3 at the ground-truth orientation, 0.58-0.97 from the painted start; at 1e-4 the fit adds noise. I59 no. Next: Gauss-Newton with spot-spread residuals (I60).

steps.title: Gauss-Newton gradient fit with spot-spread residuals
steps.result: Centroid + spot-spread residuals in Gauss-Newton: gradient relative error 1.38/0.74 at 5e-4/1e-3 from the painted start (CMA hybrid 0.97/0.58), so I60 no; but the best mean strain at the ground-truth orientation (0.95/1.4/1.1e-4) at 15 s per grain against 63 s.

steps.title: Non-linear strain-gradient sample straingq
steps.result: Sample straingq (grain mean + linear + quadratic + smooth random field, equal parts, non-linear parts orthogonal to linear): oracle linear share 0.33. Linear fits keep the mean (1.7/1.7e-4 at 5e-4/1e-3 at the ground-truth orientation, 1.9/2.5e-4 from the painted start) but explain almost none of the intragranular field (rel. error 0.98-1.10; linear floor 0.82). I61 yes (sample delivered).

steps.title: Quadratic per-grain strain field (I62)
steps.result: On straingq the quadratic field (36 numbers) beats the linear one at 1e-3 (intragranular rel. error 0.72-0.74 vs 0.98, voxel error 1.03e-3 -> 0.77e-3) but not at 5e-4 (1.09-1.24 vs 1.05-1.10). I62 no; I63 not run by the rule.

steps.title: GP prior on the intragranular strain residual (I64)
steps.result: On straingq a GP-prior residual (5 kernel eigenvectors per component over mean + linear, 48 numbers) gives intragranular rel. error 1.73/0.78 at 5e-4/1e-3 at the ground-truth orientation and 1.23/0.84 from the painted start, worse than the quadratic field. I64 no. The prior helps the same basis and keeps the 1e-4 fit flat (voxel error 1.4e-4). The strain queue I59-I64 is done.

pareto_note: Vertical axis: voxels more than 0.1 deg from the ground truth, as a percentage of all voxels in the set, pooled over grains (not a per-grain average). Horizontal axis: objective evaluations per voxel. Grey: reference points, set = all 19,013 painted voxels of grad. Coloured: GO2 arms, set = the 853 voxels of the 20 benchmark grains (G20) that have an AR3 C record (start 84 of 853, C 18 of 853).
